_comment: THE single source of truth for the instrument allowlist (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md §1). Nothing else in this repo may hard-code a symbol list: scripts/instruments.py (Python) and scripts/instruments.sh (bash/jq) are the two readers, and scripts/tests/test_instruments_sync.py fails the build if any file drifts from this one. Adding or removing a symbol = edit THIS file, run `python3 scripts/sync-instruments.py --write`, done.
_policy: analysis != execution. A symbol on the analysis list is scannable and analysable (scanner, /analyze, /bias, /entry). Only a symbol on the execution list can ever have an order placed on it (pilot, /execute, the Binance connectors). Every execution list MUST be a subset of its analysis list -- scripts/instruments.py enforces this on load and raises on violation. Forex is prohibited outright and can never appear here (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md §1).

display._comment: OPTIONAL presentation metadata. A symbol with no entry gets id = lowercase symbol minus the USDT suffix, label = the symbol, price_decimals = 2. Override only when the default is wrong.
